title: IBM Mainframes and Maintenance for the FDIC
description: The Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation requests quotes under RFQ CORHQ-26-Q-0388 for new IBM mainframes and maintenance. Offerors must complete the price schedule. Terms and conditions, EULA or MSAs must accompany the quote; FDIC prefers government-approved terms. Quotes need a letter of authorization from the manufacturer and, if applicable, a proposed GSA Schedule or NASA SEWP contract. Questions were due Oct 9, 2026; quotes are due Oct 22, 2026. IBM site numbers for FDIC are 5166681 (VASQ) and 4742836 (DFW/BDC).
